name: comet_firn
theme: glacier ice and comet ice are the same substance at two scales — a fjord under the midnight sun, down through the glacier front and a crevasse's blue chasm to the ancient air bubbles strung along the ice's flow bands, which fold out into the far comet swarm; the fall home rides one active comet down its dust cloud to an ice-cliff core that reads as the glacier front again

registers.name: fjord
registers.scene: a long fjord under a low midnight sun, seen from high above the water, dark teal water lying still between black rock walls, snowfields on the ridges above, long violet shadows across the slopes, pale gold haze along the whole inlet, a broad wall of pale teal ice standing where the water ends
registers.target: a broad wall of pale teal ice
registers.loop_target: a long fjord under a low midnight sun, dark teal water between black rock walls, a broad wall of pale teal ice at the end of it

registers.name: glacier_front
registers.scene: the front of a great glacier standing over the water, a long rampart of teal and white ice, tall fractured blocks ranked along its top edge, deep blue clefts cut down through the face, broken ice strewn on the dark water below, low gold light along the upper rim

registers.name: crevasse_field
registers.scene: the cracked upper ice of a glacier seen from straight above, long crevasses combed in smooth parallel curves around a dark rock knob, blue shadow standing in every slot, drifted snow packed between them, low gold light raking across the whole surface

registers.name: chasm
registers.scene: inside a crevasse in the glacier, blue ice walls on either side, a bright slot of gold sky far overhead, ledges of drifted snow along the walls, deep violet shadow in the depths, meltwater sheen over the blue

registers.name: flow_bands
registers.scene: a wall face of ancient glacier ice, long bands of teal and milk white folded in smooth parallel streamlines, the bands combed around dark rounded lenses set into them, fine cracks crossing the surface, wet sheen over everything

registers.name: clear_ice
registers.scene: inside a lens of clear glacier ice, faint teal streamlines running away through the blue, threads of pale round bubbles strung along them, milk-white grain boundaries crossing at the edges, gold light carried deep into the ice
registers.target: a string of pale round bubbles

registers.name: bubbles
registers.scene: ancient air bubbles trapped in deep blue ice, pale round bodies hanging at every depth in the dark blue, drawn out in long curving strings along the flow lines, faint teal streamlines behind them, cold gold light far off through the ice

registers.name: swarm
registers.scene: the far outer swarm of an old comet cloud, pale round bodies of dirty ice scattered at every depth through the black, drawn out along long curving orbital streams, faint frost glinting on each one, cold starlight far behind them

registers.name: comet
registers.palette: amber gold and blue-white on black
registers.scene: an active comet in deep space, seen from across the dark, a bright pale gold cloud of dust and ice around a small bright core, a long dust tail drawn out behind it in fine parallel streaks, a straighter blue-white tail beside it, cold stars scattered far back in the black
registers.target: a bright pale gold cloud of ice dust
registers.loop_target: an active comet in the dark, a bright gold cloud of dust around its core and a long tail drawn out behind it

registers.name: inner_coma
registers.scene: inside the bright dust cloud of an active comet, a slow field of pale gold-green light, ice grains adrift at every depth, straight jets of pale dust standing off a small bright body below, long fine streamlines combed back through the glow

registers.name: nucleus
registers.palette: low gold light, teal ice and soot black
registers.scene: the ice country of a comet's core, wide banded scarps and ridges of pale teal ice standing over dark dust plains, low gold light raking along the scarp faces, long violet shadows in the hollows, thin bright jets standing off the fractures
registers.target: a long dark inlet of still water

music_theme: cold and wide, patient — a low sub-bass drift under long bowed strings, glass-bell harmonics ticking on the ice scales, a warm gold piano figure over the fjord, the whole thing breaking open on the bubble-to-comet-swarm fold and settling back into the drift
